archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-09.1 Define Digital and Technical Requirements
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
The first step begins with understanding what the business and data processes need from the technical environment. Architects and system owners work closely with business and data experts to identify requirements for computing power, data storage, networking, security, scalability, and interoperability.
This step translates business goals into technical specifications. For example, it defines how much storage is needed for large datasets, what security level is required for sensitive data, and what tools are needed for analytical work. Requirements are collected for both current systems and future modernization projects, ensuring that the infrastructure can evolve with organizational needs.
Value created: Clear, shared understanding of what the infrastructure must deliver to support all business and data processes effectively.
